pretreatment: single side polished (1SP) and double side polished (2SP) 10 × 10 mm² STO(001) single crystal substrates. The 1SP STO substrates were used unless 2SP is specifically mentioned. The substrates were cleaned by sonicating for 10 min in acetone (99%, Fisher Scientific), isopropyl alcohol (99%, Fisher Scientific), and deionized water (18.2 MΩ cm, Barnstead EasyPure RoDi) in sequence. Then, samples were placed in a UV-ozone generator (Novascan PSD Digital UV Ozone System) for 15 min.
evidence: Single side polished (1SP) and double side polished (2SP) 10 × 10 mm² STO(001) single crystal substrates (MTI Corporation) were prepared for BaSnO3 or SrSnO3 film growth. The 1SP STO substrates were used unless 2SP is specifically mentioned. The substrates were cleaned by sonicating for 10 min in acetone (99%, Fisher Scientific), isopropyl alcohol (99%, Fisher Scientific), and deionized water (18.2 MΩ cm, Barnstead EasyPure RoDi) in sequence. Then, samples were placed in a UV-ozone generator (Novascan PSD Digital UV Ozone System) for 15 min.
